end.summary:
Practised showing numbers 11–20 as one ten-bundle and loose ones.
Saanvi named twelve, thirteen, and fourteen during examples.
They counted a ten-bundle as 1 when finding the total on repeated attempts.
The bundle-as-one mix-up remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised building numbers with one bundle of ten and loose sticks. Saanvi named several teen numbers and used the phrase “one ten and four loose ones”; the mix-up was counting the bundle as 1 instead of 10 and it was still present at the end. At home, build numbers 11–20 with 10 grouped objects plus loose ones, then ask, “How many in all?” and have Saanvi count the bundle as ten.
